messages:
morgan: Quick check — we're about to merge the streaming-toolcall PR (WIP: add partial func-arg deltas and explicit end flag). Two questions: 1) will older clients that expect a single final `tool_call` event break, and 2) do we need a minor vs major version bump for the API?

raj: short answer: older clients won't crash but might not assemble args correctly. The PR emits incremental `tool_arg_delta` events and then a `tool_call_end` with `complete: true`. Clients that only look for a single `tool_call` event will miss partially streamed args.

raj: current plan in PR: keep backward-compatible top-level `tool_call` emitted at the end for parity, but also emit deltas during stream. That avoids a hard break. See snippet: 

```json
{"type":"tool_arg_delta","tool":"search","delta":"{\"q\":\"redwood inference\"}"}
...
{"type":"tool_call_end","tool":"search","complete":true,"call_id":"abc123"}
{"type":"tool_call","tool":"search","args":{"q":"redwood inference"},"call_id":"abc123"}
```

morgan: ok that helps. Does the final `tool_call` duplication double-count telemetry/metrics?

raj: good catch — we emit the final `tool_call` as a synthesized event for compatibility but it is marked `synthesized: true` and we exclude synthesized events from metric/token billing and short-term eval hooks. We still log a single call_id so tracing ties together.

jess: +1 on compatibility. Please add a short migration note in the release notes and mark the new streaming fields as opt-in behind `streaming_tool_deltas` feature flag for Dedicated/private rollouts. Also ping infra for canary plan. @raj can you add the feature-flag gate?

raj: will do. PR updated: added `streaming_tool_deltas` gate and unit tests. Also added an integration harness that replays deltas into the assembler.

sam: FYI client-side behavior: the JS SDK currently concatenates deltas into `args_buffer` and only emits `tool_call` on `end`. If we keep the synthesized end event, old SDKs stay unchanged. I opened a tiny PR to make the SDK prefer streaming assembly when `streaming_tool_deltas` is enabled.

zoe: test harness note — I added a fuzz test that injects out-of-order delta fragments and verifies the assembler tolerates reordering and duplicate fragments. Found one edge where partial JSON pieces split a token in the middle; fixed by buffering until a valid JSON chunk is parseable.

morgan: can we sketch the canary? suggested plan: 1) enable feature-flag on staging, run integration smoke w/ harness, 2) enable on 5% of Dedicated nodes, watch tracing & error budget, 3) enable wider if no regressions for 48h.

jess: agree. I'll add the canary to the release checklist and add the rollout doc.

deploy-bot: Canary job started for eng-platform at commit `d4c3b2a` — 5% Dedicated nodes. Monitor dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/canaries/1234 :rocket:

morgan: thanks all. @raj @sam can you both please approve the PR when green? I want this merged before Friday so marketing can include it in the notes.

raj: approved (CI green).

sam: approved, left a tiny SDK follow-up.

morgan: perfect — merging after a quick sanity smoke on staging. Will follow up if anything pops up.
